lines.2: The Tsushima family was quite entertaining.
lines.3: I was glad I joined the executive council. I never got bored.
lines.4: As I was about to turn a corner in the hall...
lines.6: Were they talking behind my back?
lines.9: The huddle of girls froze, then filed away from the spot.
lines.10: 「Oh, that's wonderful. I love that sort of thing.」
lines.11: My mock-exam scores and athletic results were both earned on ability.
lines.12: Their petty little manner was irresistibly adorable.
lines.13: If possible, I wanted them to stay as servile as they were now.
lines.14: I stand far above those ordinary little people and take what I please from them.
lines.15: It is only because so many lesser people exist that a single hero stands out.
lines.16: All right. Time to keep doing things my way this afternoon.
